snippet.title: Stuffed: Two Foot Hero | Reveal Trailer | Co-op VR Shooter | Meta Quest, PC VR
snippet.description:
Hey, you're early! Make sure to Wishlist, and if you want to be a tester or streamer, join our Discord!

Stuffed Two Foot Hero is a VR sequel to our PC title Stuffed, a first-person shooter where you play as a teddy bear protecting your owner from her nightmares!
